title: The quarter, to scale
summary: How this layer runs, as one quarter drawn to scale: thirteen weeks on a ruler with the weekly signal review, the win/loss interviews as deals close or die, and week 13's red tick — the calibration readout — whose standing agenda sits beside it.
story: On this page the cadence comes before the document: the ring said ‘once a quarter’, and here is the quarter itself, week by week, ending in the meeting that re-scores the plan — which the next section shows a page of. Who's in the room and who runs it are said plainly underneath.
copy: [N, echoes approved FAQ Q3] h2 “Calibrate is a standing cadence.”
[N] legend: Weekly signal review · Win/loss interview, as deals close or die (week 13 is labelled on the drawing itself: “Calibration readout”)

[R] (FC scope) agenda: 1 What the signal says — monitoring and priorities refreshed · 2 Why deals moved — new win/loss interviews · 3 What held, what to stop — message versions and plays compared · 4 What ships next quarter — the Rebuild Sequence re-scored

[N] foot “In the room: your operator and your leadership. On retainer, we run it. Before the first quarter, the install builds the signal taxonomy from your closed-won history, stands up the win/loss interviews and puts the dashboard in your stack.”
phone: ≤1023: the ruler takes the full width; the agenda sits under it without its side rule. ≤767: a phone ruler swaps in (358×190 viewBox, every other week numbered, the red week-13 tick labelled), the legend stacks, then the foot, the link and the agenda.

reference.kelwin: Thirteen weeks instead of ten days; three kinds of mark keyed in a legend (solid weekly ticks, dashed win/loss marks, the red week-13 readout); the ruler runs on, faint, into the next quarter; the readout's standing agenda is the right-hand column.

motion: entrance (body moment one on this page, plays once): the axis draws left to right, the week numbers and weekly ticks fall in, the dashed win/loss marks appear, the faint next-quarter run fades in, week 13's red tick rises last with its label; the agenda sets item by item beside it.
